title: DOM elements in a Dear ImGui app
blurb: A Dear ImGui app compiled with Emscripten shows real <input>, <select> and <textarea> elements with one ImGui::Image() call each. ImGui scrolls, clips and covers them.
question: Is one ImGui::Image() call enough to put a live DOM element in a Dear ImGui window, with the browser handling its input?
result: Yes. The C++ side is about 40 lines and the browser side about 100. ImGui's own window lookup answers what is on top of an element.
